raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview Both incremental detokenizers hold tokens back while the decoded text ends in an incomplete UTF-8 sequence and re-decode the whole held-back run on every step. A model emitting byte tokens that never complete a code point (garbage output) therefore costs O(n²) per request and blocks the API-server event loop (`/health` hangs, every stream stalls). Cap the held-back run at `MAX_PENDING_TOKENS = 16` tokens and flush it as replacement characters. Fixes #63667. ## Claims - Per-token detokenization cost no longer grows with the length of a malformed run: 8 000 garbage tokens take 0.02 s (fast) / 0.09 s (slow) instead of 5.7 s, and 20 000 take 0.06 s / 0.23 s instead of 35.7 s / 35.2 s. - Replacement characters are streamed while the run is in progress instead of being withheld until a valid character arrives; the final text equals a full `decode()` of the same ids, including the whitespace of the text that follows the run. - Well-formed output is unaffected: a code point spans at most 4 byte tokens, so the cap is never reached by valid text. ## Validation ```bash .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/tokenizers_/test_detokenize.py -k "malformed_utf8 or does_not_leak_prompt or unrepresentable_ids" -q # 6 passed .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/tokenizers_/test_detokenize.py -k "not Llama-3.2 and not Pixtral and not mistral" -q # 508 passed, 160 skipped (gated tokenizers deselected locally; CI runs them) pre-commit run --files vllm/tokenizers/detokenizer_utils.py vllm/v1/engine/detokenizer.py tests/tokenizers_/test_detokenize.py # all hooks pass ``` | test | guards | before the fix | |---|---|---| | `test_malformed_utf8_run_is_streamed_as_replacement_chars[{fast,slow} × {gpt2, CodeLlama}]` | 1 024 lone lead-byte tokens after a prompt: at most 16 are ever held back; final text == full decode minus prompt (checks the space before ` world` survives the fast-path restart) | `AssertionError: held_back=1024 tokens never streamed` (all 4) | | `test_flush_after_prompt_ending_in_incomplete_utf8_does_not_leak_prompt` | restarting the fast stream never primes it with a prefix ending in `�` (DecodeStream would re-emit the prompt) | mutation (guard removed): prompt text appears in output | | `test_fast_detokenizer_keeps_skipping_unrepresentable_ids` | ids `DecodeStream` rejects outright (#21951 path) are still only logged and skipped, never collected for a flush | written against a first draft that collected them: `OverflowError: number too large to fit in target type` from the flush | Benchmark (`hf-internal-testing/llama-tokenizer`, prompt `"Hello"`, N × `<0xE2>` through `update()`, tokenizers 0.23.3): | detokenizer | 1 000 | 4 000 | 8 000 | 20 000 | streamed during run | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | Fast, main | 0.09 s | 1.43 s | 5.70 s | 35.7 s | 0 chars | | Slow, main | 0.09 s | 1.43 s | 5.72 s | 35.2 s | 0 chars | | Fast, this PR | 0.00 s | 0.01 s | 0.02 s | 0.06 s | all | | Slow, this PR | 0.01 s | 0.05 s | 0.09 s | 0.23 s | all | Same with the production model's tokenizer (`deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017`): 8 000 tokens 2.03 s / 2.07 s on main (0 chars streamed) vs 0.01 s / 0.22 s with this PR; 20 000 tokens 0.03 s / 0.54 s with this PR. Observed in production (vLLM 0.32.0, k8s, P/D decode instance): `/health` timing out at ~1 core CPU, `py-spy` main thread in `_protected_step`, clients receiving runs of `�`. No GPU end-to-end test is included: the behaviour lives entirely in the detokenizer objects, which the tests drive directly; model outputs are unchanged. ## Details **Root cause.** `tokenizers.DecodeStream.step()` keeps every token since the last emitted text and re-decodes that slice each step while the result ends with `�` (`step_decode_stream`, `tokenizers/src/tokenizer/mod.rs`). `detokenize_incrementally()` does the same with its `prefix_offset`/`read_offset` window (`if ... new_text.endswith("�"): return ... prefix_offset, read_offset`). Neither bounds the window, and `OutputProcessor.process_outputs` runs on the event loop. **Fix.** - `MAX_PENDING_TOKENS = 16` in `vllm/tokenizers/detokenizer_utils.py` (a UTF-8 code point is at most 4 byte tokens; the margin covers runs of skipped special tokens). - Slow path: when the window reaches the cap, fall through to the normal advance branch, which emits the `�` text and moves the offsets. Spacing context is preserved by the existing prefix window. - Fast path: `FastIncrementalDetokenizer` counts held-back ids (`step()` returned `None`). At the cap it decodes them once, emits the text, and restarts `DecodeStream` primed with the ≤4 tokens behind the last rendered text (`_context_ids`, initially the prompt tail) so the next token decodes in the same context as an unbroken stream (SentencePiece strips a leading space only at the start of a decode). A primed prefix that itself ends in `�` is ignored by `DecodeStream` and would be re-emitted, so such a context is dropped (covered by the second test). The existing invalid-prefix reset (#17448) is left as is, only clearing the counter. **Trade-offs / limitations.** - With no prompt and no previously rendered text, the restarted fast stream has no context, so a space directly after a malformed run can be lost (`"world"` instead of `" world"`); that is the same behaviour as the existing #17448 reset. Real requests have a prompt, which the first test exercises. - Text emitted for a flushed run is `tokenizer.decode(run)`, i.e. the replacement characters a full decode produces; nothing else changes for well-formed output. - Not touched: the prompt-priming cost of `DecodeStream` (#51281, #57330) and prompts ending mid-UTF-8 (#48854). All three are orthogonal and touch the same constructor lines, so expect trivial rebases. **Not a duplicate.** Searched issues/PRs for "detokenizer quadratic", "DecodeStream", "replacement character stall", "detokenize_incrementally", "byte fallback slow": #51281 and #57330 cap prompt-priming work (per-request O(prompt), not per-token growth); #48854 routes prompts ending mid-UTF-8 to the slow path; #46723 is the Rust frontend. None bounds the held-back run. ---

@@ -291,7 +305,86 @@ def test_oov_decode(tokenizer, fast):
     assert out_ids == [len(tokenizer)]
 
 
-# ---------- convert_ids_list_to_tokens collision tests ----------
+def _lone_lead_byte_token(tokenizer) -> int:
+    """A token that decodes to a single U+FFFD: a UTF-8 lead byte on its own."""
+    return next(
+        token_id
+        for token_id in range(min(len(tokenizer), 1024))
+        if tokenizer.decode([token_id]) == "�"
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "tokenizer_name", ["openai-community/gpt2", "codellama/CodeLlama-7b-hf"]
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fast", (True, False))
+def test_malformed_utf8_run_is_streamed_as_replacement_chars(tokenizer, fast):
+    """A model emitting byte tokens that never complete a code point (garbage
+    generation) must have them streamed out as U+FFFD while the run is in
+    progress. Holding them back until a valid character arrives re-decodes the
+    whole run on every step, which stalls the API server event loop on long
+    outputs, and text after the run must still decode as if never flushed."""
+    if fast and not isinstance(tokenizer, TokenizersBackend):
+        pytest.skip()
+
+    prompt = tokenizer.encode("Hello", add_special_tokens=False)
+    run = [_lone_lead_byte_token(tokenizer)] * 1024
+    tail = tokenizer.encode(" world", add_special_tokens=False)
+    detokenizer = _new_detokenizer(
+        tokenizer, prompt, skip_special_tokens=True, fast=fast
+    )
+
+    output_text = ""
+    for token_id in run:
+        detokenizer.update([token_id], False)
+        output_text += detokenizer.get_next_output_text(False, delta=True)
+    held_back = len(run) - output_text.count("�")
+    assert held_back <= MAX_PENDING_TOKENS, f"{held_back=} tokens never streamed"
+
+    for token_id in tail:
+        detokenizer.update([token_id], False)
+    output_text += detokenizer.get_next_output_text(True, delta=True)
+    prompt_text = tokenizer.decode(prompt, skip_special_tokens=True)
+    full_text = tokenizer.decode(prompt + run + tail, skip_special_tokens=True)
+    assert output_text == full_text[len(prompt_text) :]
+    assert detokenizer.output_token_ids == run + tail
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tokenizer_name", ["codellama/CodeLlama-7b-hf"])
+def test_flush_after_prompt_ending_in_incomplete_utf8_does_not_leak_prompt(
+    tokenizer,
+):
+    """Restarting the fast stream behind a malformed run must not prime it with
+    a prefix that itself ends in an incomplete sequence: DecodeStream ignores
+    such a prefix and would re-emit the prompt text as generated output."""
+    bad_byte = _lone_lead_byte_token(tokenizer)
+    prompt = tokenizer.encode("Hello", add_special_tokens=False) + [bad_byte]
+    run = [bad_byte] * (2 * MAX_PENDING_TOKENS)
+    tail = tokenizer.encode(" world", add_special_tokens=False)
+    detokenizer = _new_detokenizer(
+        tokenizer, prompt, skip_special_tokens=True, fast=True
+    )
+
+    for token_id in run + tail:
+        detokenizer.update([token_id], False)
+    output_text = detokenizer.get_next_output_text(True, delta=True)
+
+    assert "Hello" not in output_text
+    assert output_text.endswith("world")
+    assert output_text.count("�") == len(run)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tokenizer_name", ["openai-community/gpt2"])
+def test_fast_detokenizer_keeps_skipping_unrepresentable_ids(tokenizer):
+    """Ids DecodeStream cannot accept at all (#21951) are logged and skipped;
+    a run of them must not be collected for a flush that fails the same way."""
+    detokenizer = _new_detokenizer(tokenizer, [], skip_special_tokens=True, fast=True)
+    tail = tokenizer.encode(" world", add_special_tokens=False)
+
+    for token_id in [2**40] * (MAX_PENDING_TOKENS + 1) + tail:
+        detokenizer.update([token_id], False)
+
+    assert detokenizer.get_next_output_text(True, delta=True) == " world"

+# an incomplete UTF-8 sequence. A code point spans at most 4 byte-fallback
+# tokens, so a longer run is malformed output; it is flushed as replacement
+# characters so that per-token decode cost stays bounded.
+MAX_PENDING_TOKENS = 16
+
 
 def _replace_none_with_empty(tokens: list[str | None]):
     for i, token in enumerate(tokens):

 from vllm.tokenizers import TokenizerLike
 from vllm.tokenizers.detokenizer_utils import (
+    MAX_PENDING_TOKENS,

             ids=request.prompt_token_ids,
             skip_special_tokens=self.skip_special_tokens,
         )
+        # Tokens the stream has not rendered yet, and the tokens behind its
+        # last rendered text (what a restarted stream is primed with).
+        self._pending_ids: list[int] = []
+        self._context_ids: list[int] = (request.prompt_token_ids or [])[-4:]
 
         self.spaces_between_special_tokens = (
             sampling_params.skip_special_tokens
@@ -239,7 +244,7 @@ def _protected_step(self, next_token_id: int) -> str | None:
             # Handle rare observed overflow, still to be diagnosed.
             # See https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/21951.
             logger.exception("Encountered invalid token id: %r", next_token_id)
-            token = None
+            return None
         except Exception as e:
             if not str(e).startswith(INVALID_PREFIX_ERR_MSG):
                 raise e
@@ -255,8 +260,37 @@ def _protected_step(self, next_token_id: int) -> str | None:
             self.stream = tokenizers.decoders.DecodeStream(
                 skip_special_tokens=self.skip_special_tokens
             )
+            self._pending_ids.clear()
             token = self.stream.step(self.tokenizer, next_token_id)
-        return token
+        if token:
+            self._context_ids = (self._pending_ids + [next_token_id])[-4:]
+            self._pending_ids.clear()
+            return token
+        self._pending_ids.append(next_token_id)
+        if len(self._pending_ids) < MAX_PENDING_TOKENS:
+            return None
+        return self._flush_pending()
+
+    def _flush_pending(self) -> str:
+        """Render the held-back tokens as they are (replacement characters for
+        malformed bytes) and restart the stream behind them, so that a long
+        malformed run is not re-decoded in full on every step."""
+        text = self.tokenizer.decode(
+            self._pending_ids, skip_special_tokens=self.skip_special_tokens
+        )
+        self._pending_ids.clear()
+        # Prime the new stream with the text before the run so the next token
+        # decodes in the same context as in an unbroken stream. A primed prefix
+        # that itself ends in an incomplete sequence would be re-emitted.
+        context = self._context_ids
+        if self.tokenizer.decode(
+            context, skip_special_tokens=self.skip_special_tokens
+        ).endswith("�"):
+            context = []
+        self.stream = tokenizers.decoders.DecodeStream(
+            ids=context or None, skip_special_tokens=self.skip_special_tokens
+        )
+        return text
 
 
 class SlowIncrementalDetokenizer(BaseIncrementalDetokenizer):
